description.zh-CN: 接入 OpenCode CLI：server 模式复用、模型发现、Build/Plan 权限模式、会话恢复与上下文压缩。
description.en-US: Integrates the OpenCode CLI: reused server mode, model discovery, Build/Plan permission modes, session resume and context compaction.

description.zh-CN: 接入 Trae CLI：官方 traecli 走 ACP JSON-RPC，开源 trae-agent 走纯文本 run，按二进制自动切换。
description.en-US: Integrates the Trae CLI: official traecli over ACP JSON-RPC, open-source trae-agent via plain-text run, switched automatically by binary detection.

description.zh-CN: 接入 Pi coding agent：原生 JSONL RPC、会话恢复、模型与推理强度实时切换、Skill/MCP 注入、上下文压缩及 Windows PowerShell 兼容。
description.en-US: Integrates the Pi coding agent with native JSONL RPC, session resume, live model and reasoning switching, Skill/MCP injection, context compaction, and Windows PowerShell compatibility.
